Create exactly one full-body Summonlab combat chibi derived only from the supplied verified summon portrait. Canvas 1024 x 1536. Keep the character an adult and unmistakably the exact same person; simplify shapes for a clean painterly combat-game chibi. PROPORTION LOCK: the complete head-and-hair unit occupies 32 to 36 percent of the standing figure height, producing 2.75 to 3.1 heads total. Use a clearly oversized adult head, compact torso, and shortened legs; never render a 3.5-head, 4-head, or tall-miniature figure. Preserve relative body widths without generic inflation of the body. Use a grounded ready-idle three-quarter pose, both empty hands and both feet completely visible, with a generous safe margin and a warm pale parchment studio wash.

Identity continuity: Peri Tava, age 23, gender presentation woman, skin-value band 4; long narrow face; wide-set eyes and a low straight brow; crooked healed nose, balanced mouth; one cheek mole Preserve adult age cues, face geometry, skin, and expression; use a calm closed mouth with no smile or theatrical acting. Enlarge the cranium for chibi scale without replacing the source eye shape, eye spacing, brow structure, nose, mouth, jaw, or cheek planes with a shared generic doll-face template; the roster must retain visibly different adult faces at combat scale. Body continuity: healthy-slight-lanky, tall; 181 cm; healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass. Preserve shoulder and torso width, mass, softness, muscle distribution, upper-arm and forearm girth, wrist scale, hand size, leg mass, and posture. Do not make the arms, hands, shoulders, torso, or body fatter or bulkier merely because this is chibi. Tall or slight identity must read through shape and posture without shrinking the head below the required chibi ratio.

Hair continuity: blonde-gold long-loose; accent: one bound side fall. Preserve the front and side silhouette of long-loose, the parting, gathered mass, shaved areas, and one bound side fall; color remains blonde-gold. Wardrobe continuity: quilted-outerwear in ochre-cream; lightly quilted cloth outerwear over a simple fitted layer and tapered trousers; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems. Condition: deliberately tousled but clean. Preserve every visible seam, repair, closure, accessory, tattoo, marking, and palette relationship that survives at chibi scale. Personal anchors: a repaired cuff with bright thread; a tiny nose stud. Add nothing new.
